claims.text: The starting material is a crystalline, near-equiatomic solid-solution nanoparticle containing at least five metals.
Adding a stabilizing dopant to the multicomponent HEA nanoparticle is the proposed single intervention.
The stabilizing dopant will overcome operational instability.
Multicomponent HEA nanoparticles can exhibit improved catalytic stability.
The proposed intervention is effective throughout the 773–1173 K catalytic regime.
The resulting material is applicable to catalysis.
The resulting HEA material is applicable to data memory.
The resulting HEA material is applicable to energy storage.
A ligand effect arising from the polymetallic elements contributes to enhanced catalytic activity.
Optimization of the surface electronic structure contributes to enhanced catalytic activity.
The ligand and surface-electronic effects explain the improved high-temperature stability.
Catalytic activity will increase by at least 20% relative to untreated nanoparticles.
The degradation rate will decrease by at least 30% relative to untreated nanoparticles.
The compositional boundary is at least five metals plus a stabilizing dopant.
The proposed material is applicable at pressures from 1 to 10 bar.
The proposed material is applicable to gas feeds containing 10–90% reactant.
A falsification experiment compares untreated nanoparticles with stabilizing-dopant-treated HEA nanoparticles under catalytic operation.
The experiment defines a significant effect as at least a 10% activity difference or at least a 20% degradation-rate difference.

contradictions.description: The prediction requires at least a 20% activity increase and a 30% degradation-rate reduction, whereas the experiment treats a 10% activity difference or 20% degradation-rate difference as significant. Results below the predicted magnitudes could therefore be counted as experimental success.
The mechanism field attributes the outcome affirmatively to ligand and surface-electronic effects, while the uncertainty field says the exact mechanism and dopant role are not understood.
